milestones.description: Plan: 'use rituals (Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Lotus Petal, Lion's Eye Diamond) to generate a big mana burst, resolve Ad Nauseam or Past in Flames' — a ritual precedes a payoff within one turn.
Plan: 'build storm count, then kill with Tendrils of Agony' — Tendrils cast with at least 8 casts already logged this turn (derived from RECENT EVENTS; there is no storm count in the prompt).
Plan: 'Dig with Brainstorm/Ponder' — rate a cantrip is cast when offered on a play menu.
Plan: 'protect with Duress and disrupt with Cabal Therapy' — a discard spell cast some turn before the tutor/payoff turn.
Plan: 'Win from nowhere in one explosive turn' requires holding rituals plus a business spell: 3+ distinct combo pieces visible in hand.
Plan: 'resolve Ad Nauseam or Past in Flames to refuel' — a payoff/refuel spell ever cast (turn_max 99 = ever).
Plan: 'kill with Tendrils of Agony (Infernal Tutor fetches the payoff)' — Tendrils ever cast.

notes: casts_this_turn_at_least counts BOTH players' RECENT-EVENTS cast lines since the last turn marker and excludes the pending Tendrils itself; 8 prior casts gives Tendrils storm >= 8.
